svg.title: Pico 2 W pin map and SP/CE plug for the SD card
svg.desc: Every header pin of the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W colour coded by what owns it: Display Pack 2.8, UPS-B, the SD card, or free. The SD module plugs into the SP/CE connector on the Display Pack, which carries GP8 to GP11, ground, 3.3 volts and 5 volts.
svg.text: Display Pack trace, nothing on it
